observations: After helper installation, the UI showed charge paused while using AC power and the original 80% limit.
The dashboard showed current battery telemetry instead of the helper installation page.
After the application restarted, the UI opened normally; it reported the charger disconnected and battery discharge at that later observation.
The helper stayed running through the application restart.
No forced charge, discharge, calibration, or limit changes were performed for testing.
